title: Juniper and the Inheritance
author: Z. M. Quintana
blurb: Sable Halloran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
